Salazon is a human who guards a Zhentarim hideout in Act One.
“
Gah, Helm's orbs. Thought you were Flaming Fist. Down you go, then. They'll be on us soon, so if you're looking to trade you'd best be quick.
„
— Salazon, granting entry to the hideout

Involvement

Act One

Salazon guards the entrance to the Zhentarim Basement at Waukeen's Rest. See Find the Missing Shipment for details about the encounter with him.

Companion approval

The following responses grant companion approval:

  • [NON-BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] Careful. You won't kill me, but you will make me mad. (DC 15)
    •  +1  +1  +1  +1  +1
  • [WIZARD] [PERSUASION] That spell, in close quarters? You're going to hurt yourself. (DC 15 )
    • Salazon: ... let's say I'd rather not fight, then. What's your business down here?
      • [ROGUE] Flick out a single hand-sign: 'profit'.  +1  +1  +5  +1
